units.source_text: 落叶公主曾经立志终身居住在这山庄中，出家为尼。

en.t: Princess Ochiba had once resolved to spend the rest of her life in this mountain villa and become a nun.

units.source_text: 但此消息传入朱雀院耳中，朱雀院说：“此事万万不可！

en.t: But when this news reached Suzaku In, he said, "This must absolutely not be allowed!

units.source_text: 女子身事二夫，固然不是好事。

en.t: It is of course not a good thing for a woman to give herself in service to two husbands.

units.source_text: 但无保护人之少妇，一旦出家为尼，反会引起意外的恶名，而使身蒙罪愆，

en.t: But if a young woman without a protector becomes a nun, it may instead bring unexpected scandal upon her and burden her with blame,

units.source_text: 对于今世与后世两皆不利，徒然遭受世人谴责而已。

en.t: doing no good for either this life or the next, and merely bringing her the censure of the world.

units.source_text: 我已祝发入山；三公主也已身披尼装。

en.t: I have already shaved my head and entered the mountains; the Third Princess too has already put on a nun's robes.

units.source_text: 世人笑我断子绝孙，在我辈出家之人并不懊恼。

en.t: People laugh that I have cut off my line of descendants, but for those of us who have left the world, this is no cause for regret.

units.source_text: 但必欲大家如此，争先出家，毕竟无甚意味。

en.t: But to insist that everyone must do the same, rushing to take religious vows before one another, has little meaning in the end.

units.source_text: 为了人世忧患而遁入空门，声名反而不佳。

en.t: To flee into the Buddhist life merely because of worldly troubles will only harm one's reputation.

units.source_text: 必须真心感悟，静思息虑，心地澄澈，然后可以任情去留。”

en.t: Only after one has truly awakened, quietly stilled one's thoughts and worries, and made one's heart clear may one freely choose whether to leave or remain."

units.source_text: 他屡次将这番话教人传告公主。

en.t: He repeatedly had people convey these words to the princess.

units.source_text: 公主与夕雾的浮薄名声，他也曾听到。

en.t: He had also heard the frivolous rumors about the princess and Yugiri.

units.source_text: 世人都说公主因为此事不谐，所以厌世出家。

en.t: Everyone was saying that because this affair had gone badly, the princess had grown weary of the world and wished to become a nun.
When Suzaku In heard this, he became deeply worried.

units.source_text: 他认为公主公然与夕雾结缘，太过轻率，实甚不宜。

en.t: He thought it was far too rash and truly improper for the princess to form an open bond with Yugiri.

units.source_text: 但念如果向她提及，使她害羞，亦甚可怜。

en.t: But he also thought that if he brought it up with her and made her feel ashamed, that too would be very pitiful.
"Why should I trouble myself with more words?"

units.source_text: 因此关于此事绝不谈起。

en.t: For that reason, he never spoke of the matter at all.
